Its escape cases (escape_cases in review5_1253_escape.json) reached the page through the translation to JavaScript: a function nested in another, ({ name } = loop), an object with a method, an arrow made by an empty #define. Run 2026-11-09. Replayed by tests/bench_1253.js.
